Wikivoyage "Bunbury" (own page; South West Cities list: "A bustling port city with fine beaches, surfing and dolphins"); westernaustralia.com "Bunbury Geographe" page

spots.name: Cape Leeuwin Lighthouse
spots.bio: Lighthouse built in 1895 on Cape Leeuwin, where the Indian and Southern oceans meet, with guided tours of the tower.
spots.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Cape Leeuwin Lighthouse (resolve to the OSM man_made=lighthouse)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup). Headline of the southern cape; carries Cape Leeuwin (review) in its bio, as the skeptic advised.

spots.name: Ngilgi Cave
spots.bio: Show cave just outside Yallingup with a long history of Aboriginal and European use and guided or self-guided tours.
spots.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage listing geo tag (Leeuwin-Naturaliste National Park; resolve to the OSM cave entrance)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup).

spots.name: Cape to Cape Track
spots.bio: Coastal walking track from Cape Naturaliste to Cape Leeuwin, walked over several days or in day sections.
spots.coordinates_source: pin at the midpoint of the whole OSM route (resolve-pin.py); the candidate point was a LOW footway segment
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup). Run-wide decision: placed once, in wa-south-west, at the midpoint of the whole route; the whole track lies inside the region's span.

spots.name: Margaret River
spots.bio: Inland town at the heart of the wine region, the main base for its wineries, surf beaches, caves and forests.
spots.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Margaret River, Western Australia (rounded: resolve to OSM place=town)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup). The town is the destination's hub and has its own main street of food and wine; the region carries the destination name, so the town stays a spot (skeptic: "proposer decides destination vs spot").

spots.name: Jewel Cave
spots.bio: Show cave south of Margaret River with the world's longest straw stalactite found in a show cave.
spots.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage listing geo tag (resolve to the OSM cave entrance)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup).

spots.name: Lake Cave
spots.bio: Show cave with a permanent underground lake and the Suspended Table formation, seen on guided tours.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM natural=cave_entrance "Lake Cave" (LOW: confirm with resolve-pin.py)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup).

spots.name: Mammoth Cave
spots.bio: Self-guided show cave on Caves Road with the largest megafauna fossil deposit in Australia.
spots.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage listing geo tag (resolve to the OSM cave entrance)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup).

spots.name: Surfers Point
spots.bio: Margaret River's main surf break at Prevelly, with lawns for watching the surf and whales from June to December.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=viewpoint "Surfers Point" (HIGH)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup). Carries Prevelly (review) if the owner keeps the village as its own stop.

spots.name: Cape Naturaliste Lighthouse
spots.bio: Lighthouse on Cape Naturaliste near Dunsborough, with coastal views and boardwalks to a whale lookout.
spots.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage listing geo tag (resolve to the OSM man_made=lighthouse)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup). Carries Cape Naturaliste (review) and its headland walks in its bio, as the skeptic advised.

spots.name: Hamelin Bay
spots.bio: White-sand bay south of Margaret River where wild stingrays come into the shallows beside a historic jetty.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM natural=beach to be resolved (candidate point was the Wikipedia locality; Photon: place=hamlet -34.220276, 115.031347)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup).

spots.name: Meelup Beach
spots.bio: Sheltered swimming and snorkelling beach in Meelup Regional Park near Dunsborough, on a coastal trail.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM natural=beach "Meelup Beach" (HIGH)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup). Meelup Regional Park (also kept) is merged into this spot: both judges said keep one, the beach or the park, and the beach is the place visitors go; Eagle Bay and Bunker Bay, inside the park, are their own spots.

spots.name: Canal Rocks
spots.bio: Granite rocks south of Yallingup split by a sea channel, crossed by a timber walkway, with rock pools and a lookout.
spots.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Canal Rocks
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup).

spots.name: Leeuwin-Naturaliste National Park
spots.bio: National park along the capes coast holding the show caves, both lighthouses, karri forest and the Cape to Cape Track.
spots.coordinates_source: needs the park's main visitor point that no other spot uses (not the Wikipedia centroid, not Calgardup Cave, which is its own spot)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup). The park covers the same strip as the region: under "No overlapping destinations" the region visitors plan around is the destination and the park is a spot, never a destination of its own here.

spots.name: Vasse Felix
spots.bio: Margaret River's founding wine estate, with a cellar door, a wine museum and an art gallery.
spots.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Vasse Felix (resolve to the OSM winery building)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup).

spots.name: Leeuwin Estate
spots.bio: Founding Margaret River winery with a daily cellar door and a gallery of the paintings behind its Art Series labels.
spots.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Leeuwin Estate (resolve to the OSM winery building)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup).

spots.name: Boranup Forest
spots.bio: The westernmost karri forest, crossed by Boranup Drive off Caves Road, with a lookout and a picnic area.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=viewpoint "Boranup Karri Forest" (via Photon; confirm with resolve-pin.py)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup). A named stop inside Leeuwin-Naturaliste NP that the agency and board single out; the park is a spot, not a destination, so no park-in-park issue.

spots.name: Injidup Natural Spa
spots.bio: Natural rock pool on the coast near Yallingup, a short walk from the car park, about a metre deep at high tide.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=viewpoint "Inhidup Natural Spa" (via Photon; name misspelt in OSM: confirm)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup).

spots.name: Yallingup Beach
spots.bio: Surf and snorkelling beach at Yallingup, with a reef-sheltered lagoon and a well-known surf break.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM natural=beach "Yallingup Beach" (via Photon; confirm with resolve-pin.py)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup). Yallingup (the village, also kept) is merged into this spot: both judges said the beach is the town's draw and listing both would be a wrapper; the village goes in the destination description.

spots.name: Sugarloaf Rock
spots.bio: Conical granite rock off the coast south of Cape Naturaliste, a sunset stop with a car park on the Cape to Cape Track.
spots.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Sugarloaf Rock (Western Australia) (resolve to the OSM car park or viewpoint)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup).

spots.name: Dunsborough
spots.bio: Seaside town on Geographe Bay, the nearest base for Cape Naturaliste, Meelup and the northern beaches.
spots.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Dunsborough, Western Australia (rounded: resolve to OSM place=town)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup). Closer to Busselton (25 km) than to Margaret River (38 km), but filed under the capes: Tourism WA and the board treat it as the base for Cape Naturaliste and Meelup, which are Margaret River Region spots.

spots.name: Augusta
spots.bio: Town on the Hardy Inlet near Cape Leeuwin, at the south-western tip of the continent, and a base for whale watching.
spots.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Augusta, Western Australia (rounded: resolve to OSM place=town)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup). Kept as a town spot beside Cape Leeuwin Lighthouse: the inlet and whale watching are draws no other spot covers (COVERAGE: a town stays a spot when it has draws of its own).

spots.name: Gracetown
spots.bio: Small surf village on Cowaramup Bay, known for the North Point, South Point and Huzza's breaks.
spots.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Gracetown, Western Australia (rounded: resolve to OSM place=village or the bay's beach)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup). The skeptic said keep the town or its beach, not both; only the village was kept, so it carries Gracetown Beach.

spots.name: Eagle Bay
spots.bio: Calm swimming bay near Cape Naturaliste, with Point Piquet and the HMAS Swan dive wreck offshore.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM natural=beach "Eagle Bay" (via Photon; confirm with resolve-pin.py)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup).

spots.name: Bunker Bay
spots.bio: Sheltered beach beside Cape Naturaliste near Dunsborough, with a café and snorkelling.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM natural=beach "Bunker Bay Beach" (via Photon; confirm with resolve-pin.py)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup).

spots.name: Smiths Beach
spots.bio: Long white-sand beach near Yallingup with the Supertubes surf break and a snorkelling lagoon nearby.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM natural=beach "Smiths Beach" (via Photon; the enumerator's point was Yallingup's town point and is not carried over)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup).

spots.name: Redgate Beach
spots.bio: Surf beach with granite boulders south of Prevelly, linked to the Georgette wreck and Grace Bussell's rescue.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM natural=beach "Redgate Beach" (via Photon; the candidate point was the Redgate locality)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup).

spots.name: Gnarabup Beach
spots.bio: Reef-sheltered swimming and surf beach at Gnarabup, patrolled in summer, with a beach café.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM natural=beach "Gnarabup Beach" (LOW: confirm with resolve-pin.py)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup).

spots.name: Calgardup Cave
spots.bio: Self-guided show cave on Caves Road with an underground stream, beside the national park's visitor centre.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM natural=cave_entrance "Calgardup Cave" (via Photon; Wikivoyage listing point -34.052077, 115.025285 agrees within 210 m)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup).

spots.name: Giants Cave
spots.bio: Adventure cave near Boranup, 86 m deep, explored self-guided with ladders and scrambles over about an hour.
spots.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage listing geo tag (resolve to the OSM cave entrance)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup). Open only part of the year (closed May to September outside school holidays): a seasonal venue, still a spot.

spots.name: Cape Leeuwin Waterwheel
spots.bio: Waterwheel built in 1895, now encrusted in limestone, beside the road to Cape Leeuwin Lighthouse.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=attraction "Cape Leeuwin Waterwheel" (HIGH)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup). About 600 m from the lighthouse pin, so the two pins stay apart.

spots.name: Ellensbrook Homestead
spots.bio: Bussell family homestead from 1857, restored by the National Trust, on the coast north-west of Margaret River.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM historic=building "Ellensbrook" (via Photon; the candidate note's "near Augusta" was wrong, as the skeptic said)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup).

spots.name: Capes Raptor Centre

spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup). Successor to Eagles Heritage at the same Boodjidup Road site; there is no existing Eagles Heritage spot, so no duplicate.

spots.name: Cowaramup

spots.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Cowaramup, Western Australia (rounded: resolve to OSM place=village)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup).

spots.name: Yallingup Maze

spots.coordinates_source: OSM leisure=maze "Yallingup Maze" (HIGH)
spots.note: Inside the Margaret River Region span and reached from its bases (Margaret River, Dunsborough, Augusta, Yallingup).

spots.name: Busselton Jetty
spots.bio: Timber jetty almost 2 km long into Geographe Bay, with a train to the end and an underwater observatory.
spots.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage listing geo tag (resolve: the pin is the jetty's shore end or midpoint)
spots.note: Inside Busselton's span and reached from the city. The Underwater Observatory (rejected as part of the jetty) goes in this bio. Also inside the Margaret River Region's span, but visitors reach it from Busselton itself.

spots.name: Wonnerup House

spots.coordinates_source: OSM historic=manor "Wonnerup House" (via Photon; Wikivoyage listing point -33.6276, 115.433 agrees within 150 m)
spots.note: Inside Busselton's span and reached from the city.

spots.name: Busselton Museum
spots.bio: Local history museum in the 1918 Old Butter Factory, with rooms on dairying, timber, the sea and group settlement.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=museum "The Busselton Museum" (LOW: check the building)
spots.note: Inside Busselton's span and reached from the city.

spots.name: Tuart Forest National Park
spots.bio: Small national park east of Busselton protecting tuart forest, with walks among the tall trees.
spots.coordinates_source: needs the park's visitor point (picnic area or walk trailhead) from OSM or DBCA, not the Wikipedia centroid
spots.note: Inside Busselton's span and reached from the city. A small park with no kept spots of its own, so not a destination (COVERAGE: such parks go under the nearest real destination); its centroid is 19 km from Busselton, inside the 26 km span. If its visitor point falls beyond 19.5 km, widen the span to 30 km.

spots.name: Dolphin Discovery Centre

spots.note: Inside Bunbury's span and reached from the city. Carries Koombana Beach (review, a near-duplicate per the skeptic) in its bio.

spots.note: Inside Bunbury's span and reached from the city.

spots.name: Bunbury Regional Art Gallery

spots.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=museum "Bunbury Regional Art Gallery" (LOW: name and type match)
spots.note: Inside Bunbury's span and reached from the city.

spots.note: Inside Bunbury's span and reached from the city.

spots.note: Inside Collie's span and reached from the town. Three kept spots of its own (below four), so a spot of Collie rather than a destination; see the destination's shape_note.

spots.name: Wellington Dam

spots.coordinates_source: needs the mural lookout or kiosk point from OSM (the candidate point was the hydro power station's Wikipedia article)
spots.note: Inside Collie's span and reached from the town.

spots.note: Inside Collie's span and reached from the town. 20 km from Collie, inside the 30 km span.

spots.note: Inside Collie's span and reached from the town. The skeptic noted it is a near-twin of Black Diamond Lake; both were kept, so both are placed.

spots.coordinates_source: needs a trailhead or the network's midpoint from Trails WA or OSM (the candidate note's "near Bridgetown" was wrong)
spots.note: Inside Collie's span and reached from the town.

spots.note: Inside the Southern Forests span and reached from Pemberton, Manjimup or Northcliffe.

spots.name: Beedelup Falls

spots.name: Pemberton

spots.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Pemberton, Western Australia (rounded: resolve to OSM place=town)
spots.note: Inside the Southern Forests span and reached from Pemberton, Manjimup or Northcliffe. If the owner reads it as a wrapper, fold it into the destination description.

spots.name: Yeagarup Dunes

spots.note: Inside the Southern Forests span and reached from Pemberton, Manjimup or Northcliffe. Reached by the Pemberton side road; 19 km from Pemberton.

spots.note: Inside the Southern Forests span and reached from Pemberton, Manjimup or Northcliffe. One kept spot of its own, so a spot of the region, not a destination.

spots.coordinates_source: needs the day-use area point (the candidate point is the reservoir centroid, in the water)
spots.note: Inside the Southern Forests span and reached from Pemberton, Manjimup or Northcliffe.

spots.name: Bridgetown

spots.name: Bibbulmun Track
spots.bio: Long-distance walking track of about 1,000 km from Kalamunda in the Perth Hills to Albany through the southern forests.
spots.coordinates_source: pin at the midpoint of the whole OSM route=hiking relation (resolve-pin.py), per the run-wide decision
spots.note: Run-wide decision: placed once, here, at the midpoint of the whole route. A 1,000 km track crosses several destinations and belongs to none (COVERAGE: a long linear feature is not a spot of whatever it touches). If its midpoint falls within 40 km of a proposed destination's centre, it still stands alone for this reason.

spots.name: Ferguson Valley

spots.name: Gnomesville

spots.name: Harvey
